shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; sed -n '1,220p' package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next config ---'; for f in next.config.*; do [ -f \""'$f" ] && { echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; }; done'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/*.tsx; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg -i 'partial|ppr|cache-components|loading|suspense|prerender' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- migration guide ---'; sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- loading convention ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache life api docs candidates ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f | rg '/(use-cache|cacheLife|cacheTag|cache-components)' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f | rg 'cache-components|getting-started/caching|instant-navigation|streaming' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- cacheComponents config ---'; sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- use cache ---'; sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cacheLife ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- caching prerender section ---'; rg -n \"Prerendering|Suspense|static shell|Uncached data|runtime data\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- repo state ---'; git status --short; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig/css/all root files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,220p'; [ -f tsconfig.json ] && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- shell strings ---'; rg -n -o \"Dashboard|Loading dashboard|Total Revenue|Latest Invoices|Revenue\" .next/server/app .next/server/chunks 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- git diff ---'; git diff -- tsconfig.json app package.json next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- prerendered shell content ---'; rg -o \"Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Loading revenue…|Loading invoices…|Loading dashboard\" .next/server/app/index.html | sort | uniq -c; printf '%s\\n' '--- shell segment content ---'; rg -o \"Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Loading revenue…|Loading invoices…|Loading dashboard\" .next/server/app/index.segments/_shell.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c; printf '%s\\n' '--- app diff stats ---'; git diff --stat -- app; printf '%s\\n' '--- app diff ---'; git diff -- app; printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- final files ---'; sed -n '1,220p' app/dashboard-data.ts; sed -n '1,260p' app/DashboardSections.tsx; sed -n '1,300p' app/DashboardSkeletons.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff check ---'; git diff --check; printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/page.tsx; nl -ba app/loading.tsx; nl -ba app/DashboardSections.tsx; nl -ba app/DashboardSkeletons.tsx; nl -ba app/dashboard-data.ts'
